items.title: 🇲🇦Morocco Sisters retreat

items.desc:
Umrah - A Journey Home 🤍

This retreat has been close to our hearts for many years, and Alhamdulillah, we now have the opportunity to share it with our community for a third year running.

Together, we’ll explore places that have shaped our Islamic history, walk through landscapes connected to the lives of the Prophets and the Sahabah (may Allah be pleased with them) and experience these stories in a way that brings them vividly to life. Alongside our visits to Makkah and Madinah, we’ll spend time reflecting, reconnecting with ourselves, and strengthening our relationship with Allah.

Whether this is your first Umrah or you’ve been blessed to visit before, we pray this journey allows you to experience these sacred places with fresh eyes and an open heart.
items.title: 🕋A Journey Home
